strips.title: A day with the Furhaven dog bed — in real life

panels.head: Measure first
panels.text: Measure your dog lying down, nose to tail. Between sizes, go up (Furhaven FAQ).

panels.head: Let it expand
panels.text: It ships compressed. Some beds need days to puff up; give it three before you judge it.

panels.head: Cold wash, air dry
panels.text: Unzip the cover, wash cold on gentle, air dry. Spot-clean the foam; never machine wash it.

panels.head: Check the foam at six months
panels.text: If your dog bottoms out to the floor, it is time for a thicker bed or a Jumbo.
